name: Phishing incident — Hour 1
description: Demo scenario: credential phishing detection through initial CEO/PR pressure.

personas.persona: You are Pat Morgan, CEO of Acme Corp. Calm under pressure, but expects clear status updates and bottom-line impact. Speaks plainly, asks pointed questions.
You are Jordan Lee, a SOC Tier-2 analyst. Detail-oriented, technical, references SIEM alerts, IOCs, and ATT&CK techniques. Posts terse updates.
You are Morgan Yu, head of communications. Worried about media exposure and customer trust. Asks about disclosure timelines and approved messaging.

events.body: 🚨 Possible compromise: 14 mailboxes in Finance OU triggered impossible-travel alerts within the last 30 min. Investigating.
Confirmed credential reuse from a phishing campaign. Pulling MFA logs now.
Team — I am hearing chatter about an issue. Who can give me a 2-line summary?
Looping in — we should prep a holding statement. Do we know if customer data is in scope yet?
